title: Mayer, Conner / Incident Reference
summary: Restricted incident reference concerning Conner Mayer and the event in which LY-7-7 was removed from an Apex facility.
body:
SUBJECT

MAYER, CONNER

Conner Mayer is identified in Apex incident documentation as the individual responsible for removing LY-7-7 from a Lyrix facility during an attack.

The available record does not establish his full affiliation, motive or subsequent whereabouts. Several sections of the originating incident report are missing.

The name appears independently in later records under circumstances that have not yet been reconciled.

CROSS-REFERENCE

ARC-326-0425 — Lyrix Programme / Apex
